acceptanceCriteria: Provide a supported pending clientThreadId to actual thread identity/status resolution, or explicitly expose the unavailable boundary and durable recovery route.
Verify requested chat title and project/worktree identity survive queued creation and are discoverable through the native chat-management inventory; preserve exact receipt and runtime-version limits.
body: Observed 2026-09-30 coordinating requested Corvint issue cohort. mcp__codex_app__create_thread returned only clientThreadId client-new-thread:1bddfa09-aaf4-4117-9d54-036bce7bc4fe for corpus #399/#397. Later list_threads limit10 then bounded expansion30 and archived first page10 did not expose corpus, while native queue attempt b32cdc59d07f9b151d2338c02a0e3381 generation43 was active and lane-corpus-status.json named worktree /Users/russelllewis/.codex/worktrees/0d4c/corvint. No callable creation-status resolver for that client handle was found in available tool metadata. Exact-cwd read-only local thread metadata found earliest root01a0f2aa-89d0-7380-9a17-f48e25357aed with blank title. wait_threads on that observed ID confirmed active corpus execution and matching parity-review work. Supported set_thread_title succeeded, but subsequent list_threads still did not list that active corpus root. A workflow root at exact worktree40f6 also had blank title metadata. No chat transcript scan, state mutation or guessed UUID was needed; only exact-cwd metadata used. This is confirmed discovery/identity friction in the enabled Codex app tooling, with upstream cause UNKNOWN; it does not prove a Core or Tasks implementation bug. Installed Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163; Tasks developer build202; Codex app/tool runtime version NOT_OBSERVED. Expected: queued creation yields a supported resolvable owner identity; actual: handoff required read-only local metadata fallback. Retained dispatch /tmp/corvint-parallel-dispatch/dispatch.json and tool receipts in coordinator chat01a0f2a2-7c1c-7af2-acce-0f7cabb8ce0f. Owning project queue follows standing owner instruction for tooling gaps; upstream qualification/repair remains open.
title: Codex queued chat owner identity is not discoverable through chat tools
